adminWhiteLabel.description: Brands of resellers and Enterprise organizations, and their own web addresses.
adminWhiteLabel.none: No brands yet. Switch on white label for a reseller, or an Enterprise organization sets its brand in Settings.
adminWhiteLabel.stepsTitle: Giving a brand its own web address
adminWhiteLabel.step1: The brand owner adds a DNS record for the address (e.g. signage.dealer.com), as shown by Firebase in the next step.
adminWhiteLabel.step2: Firebase console → Hosting → Add custom domain: add the address and wait until it is connected (certificate issued).
adminWhiteLabel.step3: Firebase console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains: add the same address, so sign-in works there.
adminWhiteLabel.step4: Here: add the address to the brand. The sign-in page there shows the brand, and email links use it.
adminWhiteLabel.limits: Not branded: Firebase’s own emails (email verification, password reset) and the Android app’s name and pairing screen.
adminWhiteLabel.domainsHint: One per line, up to 5, e.g. signage.dealer.com.
adminWhiteLabel.badDomain: “{{domain}}” is not a valid host name.
adminWhiteLabel.firebaseReminder: Also add each address in Firebase Hosting and Authentication (authorized domains); see the steps below the list.
